value.rationale: The complete Euclidean facet-area multiset is a natural geometric boundary invariant in a foundational family of root polytopes. A sharp rare-facet dominance transition for the squared-area energy at q=10 contrasts with the uniform-facet Gaussian-square weak limit, which is not implied by bare facet enumeration or inradius computations.
